svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Alert button (counter) (obc-alert-button, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Alerts and status. Box 144x48 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_count (default 0, read): Number of active alerts _ps_type (default 'alarm', read): Highest alert type: alarm | warning | caution (idle when count is 0) _pb_blinking (default false, read): Blink (unacknowledged alerts) _pb_command (default false, write): Written 1 on click (e.g. acknowledge / silence request)
